page_title: FRE 1-1 HOF | Freiburg v Hoffenheim 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+2' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Hoffenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

90' Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim) controls the ball from the free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up in the left side of the goal but for a magnificent save by Noah Atubolu. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hoffenheim comes to nothing.

88' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Noah Atubolu makes a great save to stop his effort. Hoffenheim will take a corner kick.
85' That's the end of the game for Fisnik Asllani, who is replaced by Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim).
85' Substitution. Wouter Burger did his best and is replaced by Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim).
84' We are about to witness a substitution. Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is replacing Eren Dinkci.
84' Julian Schuster has decided to make a change. Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) replaces Jan-Niklas Beste.
82' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Bastian Dankert blows for a foul.
80' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
77' Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
75' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Good work from Hoffenheim as they win a corner.
73' Christian Ilzer has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) replacing Leon Avdullahu.
73' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Andrej Kramaric as he is replaced by Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim).
72' Bastian Dankert interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim).
69' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

69' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
68' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul after Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) hacks down one of his opponents.
68' The resulting set piece from Freiburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

67' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball goes out of play. Freiburg are awarded a corner kick.
66' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
64' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Vincenzo Grifo and he is replaced by Derry Scherhant (Freiburg).
64' The substitution is prepared. Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Junior Adamu.
62' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
61' The attendance is 33700.
60' Julian Schuster (Freiburg) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
60' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) is penalised for a foul. Bastian Dankert had a clear view and blows his whistle.
59' Substitution. Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim) in, Alexander Prass out.
57' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
54' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Freiburg was in an offside position.
53' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for an infringement.
52' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
51' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts. Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick.
51' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Freiburg get a corner.
50' A pass by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
49' Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) commits a foul and Bastian Dankert immediately signals a free kick.
48' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

46' Junior Adamu (Freiburg) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
46' Bastian Dankert blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) was quite harsh and Bastian Dankert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+3' Freiburg hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
45' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
43' The corner kick from Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

42' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) controls the ball from the resulting free kick inside the six-yard box, but his effort is blocked by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
41' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
40' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
38' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) brings an opponent down and Bastian Dankert interrupts the game.
38' It looks like Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Julian Schuster replaces him with Philipp Treu.
37' Looks like Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
36' Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
36' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
34' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) makes a rough challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
33' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
32' Eren Dinkci (Freiburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Freiburg are awarded a corner kick.
31' Arthur Chaves (Hoffenheim) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Bastian Dankert saw the whole situation.
31' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on. Bernardo (Hoffenheim) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.

27' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment. Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
26' Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) stretches for the rebound inside the box, but can only send it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
22' Bastian Dankert blows the whistle, Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) is penalised for a foul.
21' A big rebound finds it way to Bernardo (Hoffenheim), whose attempted long-range shot is almost immediately blocked by one of the opposition players.
19' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

17' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) gathers a rebound, beats his marker and goes for goal from distance, but one of his own teammates inadvertently blocks the effort. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
17' The resulting corner from Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
16' Anthony Jung (Freiburg) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The linesman points to the corner flag, Freiburg are going to take it.

15' Good chance for Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) as he latched on to a cross on the edge of the box and blasted the ball towards the net! It flew wide of the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.

13' 1 - 1 Goal! Vladimir Coufal produces a great pass that finds Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a low shot into the back of the net. 1:1.
12' The foul by Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) was seen by Bastian Dankert who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
9' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
8' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) commits a rough foul. Bastian Dankert stops the game and makes a call.

7' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the bottom left corner, but Noah Atubolu pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
3' 1 - 0 Referee Bastian Dankert points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) goes wild in celebration.
3' The Freiburg players joy may have been justified, because referee Bastian Dankert is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
3' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
3' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
1' The match has just started.
Hoffenheim will kick-off.
Bastian Dankert will supervise the game today.
